c74object.name: ambitap.directional~
c74object.digest: Apply a per-direction gain to a higher-order ambisonics bus (gain = 1 bypass, > 1 boost, < 1 attenuate)
c74object.description: Apply a per-direction gain to a higher-order ambisonics bus (gain = 1 bypass, > 1 boost, < 1 attenuate). Order is a creation arg.

attribute.name: azimuth
attribute.description: Boost-direction azimuth in radians. 0 = front, pi/2 = left.

attribute.name: elevation
attribute.description: Boost-direction elevation in radians. 0 = horizon, pi/2 = zenith.

attribute.name: gain
attribute.digest: Linear gain at the look direction
attribute.description: Linear gain at the look direction. 1 = bypass, 0 = attenuate, >1 = boost.
